# Chariot raid

Used in [Special rules](/rules/90-special).

## Table

| Die | Damage dice |
|---|---|
| 1 | 3 |
| 2–3 | 2 |
| 4–5 | 1 |
| 6 | 0 |

## Notes

- Chariot Raid Table: one die when the Italian 10th Light Flotilla raids Alexandria (rules/90-special.md, SPI 30.4x); the row gives how many dice to roll, their total being the damage points spread over the ships in the hex as the Axis player likes
- On the Axis player's chart set (jp2 176), not the shared sheet. Transcribed from the archive.org scan and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan (scan:discord:Axis Charts.pdf:p34): 0 of 4 rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no charts
